question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query: SELECT CASE WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 'No item lines' WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line' ELSE 'More than one item line' END AS ORDER_LINE_CATEGORY, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT, COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS SHARE_OF_ALL_2025_ORDERS, AVG(CASE WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 0 THEN ITEM_QUANTITY END) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_PER_ORDER FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 1 WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
action.metrics: 2025 order count and share of all orders by item-line category; average ordered units per order for orders with item lines
action.group_by: No item lines, one item line, more than one item line
